title: Fair Treatment of Subcontractors in Government Projects
what_it_is: Fair Treatment of Subcontractors in Government Projects

sections.label: Subcontractor rights and SOPA
sections.summary: Subcontractor rights and obligations are governed by contracts, with SOPA providing adjudication, and Government projects using stringent procurement and BCA registration criteria.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The rights and obligations of subcontractors, which are generally engaged directly by the main contractors, are governed by their respective contractual provisions.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To protect subcontractors, the Government has put in place the Building and Construction Industry Security of Payments Act (SOPA).

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The SOPA improves cash-flow in the construction industry by providing fast and low-cost adjudication to resolve payment disputes.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For Government construction projects, there are additionally stringent procurement systems in place for the evaluation and award of tenders.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For example, all contractors are required to meet the strict qualifying criteria under BCA's Contractor Registration System before they can tender for Government construction projects.
